summary: Wizard 0.11.1 --pinned skips CLI self-update but its SDD 1.7 scaffold still performs the default template update, so descriptor 0.11 does not establish installed Templates 0.11. Released Wizard 0.16 forwards --no-update but also passes a default player bundle unsupported by Templates 0.11. Merged Templates receiver source at 652d70e declares a distinct Wizard 0.11.1/SDD 1.7/Templates 0.19 legacy-selector cohort, separating requested descriptor from actual archive/member and templatePinning=false; clean/sdd-none 0.11 and retained 0.10 remain historical. Strict custody and pre-adoption source/config/registry/parameter guards precede explicit SignalR dependency maintenance. Original failures remain failures; neither source preparation nor focused tests establish complete hosted receiver acceptance or installed WASM acceptance. Read the owning report and refresh current source/checks before reuse.
title: Wizard descriptor and installed template require separate cohort identities
